modelNotes: Assists Board 1.0 uses season assists, last 5 assists, last 10 assists, expected minutes, minutes confidence, usage, position role, and recent assist trend.
Assists Board 2.0 adds minutes scaling, opponent assist rank, pace, rest, teammate absence redistribution, volatility, and floor/ceiling ranges.
No odds or betting lines are used.

injury.shortComment: George (illness) has been downgraded to questionable for Sunday's game against Minnesota.
injury.detail: George presumably woke up under the weather before being a late addition to the injury report. If the star point guard is unable to suit up, Darryn Peterson could see additional on-ball duties. Additionally, Isaiah Collier and Svi Mykhailiuk would be candidates for increased playing time.

injury.shortComment: Markkanen is questionable for Sunday's game against the Timberwolves due to a right wrist sprain.
injury.detail: Markkanen initially injured his wrist Oct. 26 against the Grizzlies, and although he has played in four games since then, he may be at risk of sitting out Sunday's contest. Josh Green could get another look in the starting lineup if Markkanen is unable to play.

injury.shortComment: Robinson (illness) is questionable for Sunday's game versus Milwaukee, Bobby Krivitsky of Forbes.com reports.
injury.detail: Robinson isn't feeling well, so he may not be available against the Bucks, which would mark his second absence of the 2026-27 campaign. If Robinson can't suit up, it should mean more minutes for Luka Garza behind Neemias Queta.

injury.shortComment: Trent (illness) has been downgraded to questionable for Sunday's game against Boston.
injury.detail: Trent was a late addition to the injury report due to an illness. The veteran wing has totaled 13 minutes over two regular-season appearances, so his potential absence wouldn't impact the rotation.
